title: First-principles study of the electrochemical properties of NaFeCl4 for cathode applications in sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,51018-51026
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06124E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Suk-Gyong Hwang, Tae-Il Ri, Ryo-Gyong Choe, Chung-Hyok Rim, Chol-Jun Yu
We studied the structural, electronic, and lattice vibrational properties, as well as the ionic conductivity and electrode potential, of NaFeCl4 using first-principles calculations for cathode applications in all-solid-state sodium-ion batteries.
